div.h1: D8 · Pigeonhole — k edits over k+1 pieces ⇒ ≥1 clean piece

text.tspan: piece 3 is an EXACT substring of the matching term

div.p: Why 2k+1 for Transposition / Merge-Split? A single boundary-spanning transposition (e.g. "ABCDE" → "ACBDX") or merge can corrupt two adjacent pieces at once, so k edits may dirty up to 2k pieces — 2k+1 pieces guarantee one survivor. (Counts are Coq-verified upstream.)
